proposal.expected_benefit: This will prevent potential exploitation of audit integrity gaps and ensure that the defense is robust against real-world adversarial scenarios.
proposal.problem: The defense response relies on simulation-only attack scenarios and high confidence in detection, which may lead to overreliance on current controls without real-world validation.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to ensure that all audit integrity mitigations are tested in real-world environments, including live simulations and controlled penetration testing, to identify and address potential exploitation of audit integrity gaps.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-World Testing of Audit Integrity Controls
